transcript.text: Hey everyone, I wanted to get the ball rolling on this gear swap discussion. Cal, I know you've expressed interest in trading with me, and I'm definitely open to considering an informal swap for a compact synthesizer. But before anything gets finalized, I need to follow my usual routine: whoever's proposing the trade needs to spell out every item and service included, and I need to check with June about any band schedule deadlines that might affect timing. So Cal, if you're still interested, lay out exactly what you're offering. And June, let me know if there's anything coming up on the band schedule I should be aware of.

transcript.text: Hey Rhea, glad to hear you're open to it! Let me lay out my complete offer for you. I'm offering my Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer — it's a compact synth, so that should fit what you're looking for. Included in the swap: the synth itself, its original power adapter, and the soft case it came with. I'd also provide a 30-minute setup session to help you get familiar with it. For timing, I'm available for pickup on Friday at 6:00 p.m. Let me know what you and June figure out regarding the band schedule, and we can go from there!
